title: Design Handoff link run — the script's own notes, beside the brief (schema design-handoff-link-run v1)
description: 0.16.0 — written by the link-run script (the toolkit handoff/design-handoff-script) as `<brief>.link-run.json`, beside a brief that is exactly the plugin's. It holds what the script adds to the plugin's export: the Figma file version it read, the Design System Handoff exports it joined, each source file the layer uses, and its findings. It names its brief by the brief's `contentHash`. `handoff-css validate` reads it next to the brief it names, reports every finding as a warning and requires every named export in the set. Briefs made before 0.16.0 carry the same object as `linkRun` inside the brief; both stay readable, never both at once.

unboundValues.description: Every value the layer states as a plain number, not bound to a Figma variable, one row per layer and property. `handoff-css match --export <brief>.json` matches each to the closest of the project's own coded tokens. Spacing, size, radius, border and colour come from the plugin's own unbound-value warnings; type from each text layer's own style.

value.description: `#RRGGBBAA` for colour (paint opacity folded into the alpha); a number in px otherwise (font weight unitless).

linkRun.description: Appended by the link-run script (the toolkit handoff/design-handoff-script), never by the plugin: the Figma file version it read, the Design System Handoff exports it joined, each source file the layer uses, and its findings. `handoff-css validate` reports every finding as a warning and requires every named export in the set.
